Scouting report · updated Thu, Nov 12

Luka
Dončić

The league's leading scorer. He makes defenses choose between the drive and the step-back, then punishes whichever they pick. He has scored 40 or more in six of his last seven games.

Signature move

The step-back three

He sells the drive with a hard jab, crosses the ball back between his legs to his left as he hops back off both feet, and rises before the defender recovers. At 6-8 he releases over most guards, so a late contest rarely bothers the shot.
